title: Destroy All Humans! 2 - Reprobed
summary: Destroy All Humans! 2 - Reprobed is THQ Nordic's remake of the 2006 alien action game, released on Switch 2 on September 15, 2026, at $39.99. The install is 20.4 GB, a medium size that fits easily on the 256 GB console. The physical version is a Game-Key Card, so the cartridge only unlocks the download, and you need an internet connection and that free space to start playing. No resolution or frame rate figures have been published for the Switch 2 version yet; this page will be updated when reliable tests are available. It supports 11 languages, including Spanish.
